$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (seed-opencorporates-source). Seeds the pre-built `opencorporates` OpenConnector source consumed by the OpenRegister OpenCorporates company-search integration leaf (OpenCorporatesProvider SOURCE_ID='opencorporates'). Ships dormant (isEnabled:false) with the real OpenCorporates v0.4 API base URL and auth:apikey so a fresh install resolves the endpoint without carrying a secret. The OpenCorporates API authenticates with an `api_token` query parameter — operators paste their OpenCorporates API token into the source's `configuration.query.api_token` (or the auth credential field) and flip isEnabled via the OpenConnector Sources UI. No end-user input reaches the request URL, so there is no SSRF surface (the base URL is admin-owned on the source).
